data.name: Protos Magos
data.detailed_description:
Protos Magos is a fast-paced first-person action game where you customise your attacks and change how they behave to create a build that fits your play style. Fight through dark medieval levels and blast apart hordes of demons before they surround you.

Combine runes to create custom attacks. The first rune defines the attack’s core form — a burst of ice shards, an explosive fire orb, a piercing lightning lance, a toxic pool, an earth spike, or a sustained dark ray. The runes after that change how the attack behaves.

Fight through castles, graveyards, cathedrals, and demon-infested arenas inspired by old-school action level design. Combat is fast and positional: keep moving, aim carefully, and don’t let the horde flank you.

Fire orbs. Earth spikes. Toxic pools. Lightning lances. Explosive shards. Castles. Graveyards. Custom attacks. Demons.

Lots and lots of demons.

Customise your attacks. Survive the horde. Keep moving.

data.short_description: Protos Magos is a Spellcrafting FPS with fast-paced combat. Explore a medieval setting and blast your way through a horde of demons. Create custom spells to suit your unique play style.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 6-core CPU, Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 GB VRAM dedicated GPU, RTX 3050 / RX 580 8GB or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 6-core / 12-thread CPU, Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB+ VRAM dedicated GPU, RTX 3060 / RTX 2080 / RX 6600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 18 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Fantasy violence, blood, and dismemberment of fantastic beasts and demons. Most blood is colored,like blue and green
